visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen layout showing a man in a striped shirt holding yellow boxes, an illustration of a dachshund, and a real dachshund sitting by a window. The man is smiling and gesturing towards the products. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a cafe where several dachshunds of different colors are walking on the wooden floor near customers' feet. A wall in the background is covered with various Polaroid photos and aesthetic decorations. (3) A close-up shot shows a menu titled 'OUR SIGNATURE' featuring various coffee and tea drinks with dachshund-themed names and latte art. A hand is seen gently petting a dachshund resting on a tan fabric chair. (4) The man is shown opening a yellow cardboard blind box in a bright indoor setting. He removes a silver foil package from the box and appears very excited, looking directly at the camera with wide eyes. (5) He tears open the foil package to reveal a small brown plush dachshund keychain holding a green broom. He displays the item proudly to the camera, rotating it to show details. (6) A different person with tattoos on their arm is shown demonstrating a brown dachshund-head-shaped card holder pouch. They insert a card into the back and detach a clip to show its functionality. (7) The camera captures the glass storefront of the 'BENKOFF' cafe, which features large cartoon illustrations of dachshunds on the windows and a sign indicating business hours. (8) The final shot shows the man standing outside the cafe in daylight, waving goodbye with one hand while holding a bag and three different dachshund plush keychains in the other.
